items.question: What is the highest mountain peak in North America?
items.answer: So, you're wondering about the highest mountain peak in North America, huh? Well, I've got the answer for you! It's Denali, formerly known as Mount McKinley, located in Alaska, USA. It stands at an impressive 20,310 feet (6,190 meters) above sea level. That's a whopping 3,000 feet (914 meters) higher than the next closest peak, Mount Logan in British Columbia, Canada. Denali is not only the highest peak in North America but also one of the Seven Summits, the highest peaks on each of the seven continents.

items.question: Who was the leader of the Soviet Union during World War II?
items.answer: So, during World War II, the leader of the Soviet Union was Joseph Stalin . He was the General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union from 1922 until his death in 1953. Stalin played a crucial role in the Soviet Union's war effort , and his leadership helped the country withstand the brutal invasion by Nazi Germany. He was a key figure in the Allied victory, and his leadership helped to turn the tide of the war on the Eastern Front. Despite his brutal reputation, Stalin is still remembered as a hero in the Soviet Union for his role in defeating Nazi Germany.

items.question: What is the currency used in Japan
items.answer: So, the currency used in Japan is the Japanese yen (JPY). It's the official currency of Japan and is widely accepted throughout the country. You'll find ATMs and currency exchange offices at major airports, train stations, and tourist areas. It's a good idea to have some yen with you when you arrive in Japan, especially if you're planning to take a taxi or buy something from a street vendor. But don't worry, many places in Japan also accept major credit cards, so you can still get by even if you don't have cash on hand.
